question: Which of the following Amendment Acts amended the Preamble of the Constitution for the words ’unity of the Nation’ to the words ’unity and integrity of the Nation’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**42ⁿd Amendment Act.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** 42nd Amendment **changed the words** "unity of the nation"** to **"unity and integrity of the nation".**
 
• The **42nd Amendment Act 1976**, proceed by the Indian National Congress led by** Indira Gandhi.**
 
• It is one of the most exceptional amendments to the Indian Constitution proceed by the **Indian National Congress.**
 
• **Secular and Socialist** were the two words attach after to the preamble of the Indian constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constitution **105th Amendment Act **- restored the power of State governments to acknowledge socially and educationally backward classes (SEBCs).​ 
 
• **Article 81** of the Constitution, the words and figures "not below one member for every **750,000 of the population and" shall be leave out.**
 
• **35th Amendment** committed a set of conditions that made Sikkim an** "Associate State",** a exceptional designation not used by any other state.
